blockers.title: The docs-only CI scope compares each push only with the push before it. A docs-only push that follows a failed or cancelled code push therefore runs only `verify`, and Pages then deploys code that never passed the browser suite.
blockers.evidence: scripts/ci-scope.mjs:27-41 lists the changed files from `${before}..${after}`, where before is github.event.before, the tip of the previous push. It never asks whether CI passed on that tip. .github/workflows/ci.yml:9-12 cancels a superseded run (cancel-in-progress), and ci.yml:36-43 runs only `npm run verify` when browser=false. deploy-pages.yml:16-20 and 35-38 deploy whenever a push run ends in success. Running `node scripts/ci-scope.mjs 04bdc51 0bd07d8` prints `browser=false`. 04bdc51 is the Linux-font layout fix, which only CI's browser suite can prove; 0bd07d8 is the evidence-only commit that followed it.
blockers.reproduction: 1) Push code commit A to main (e.g. 04bdc51); CI run A starts verify:all. 2) Before it finishes, push docs-only commit B (e.g. 0bd07d8). The concurrency group cancels run A, so A's conclusion is cancelled and nothing is deployed for it. 3) Run B computes the A..B diff, which holds only .evidence/ and .md files, so browser=false and it runs `verify`, which passes. 4) deploy-pages sees a successful push run and publishes B's tree, which contains A's untested src changes. The same happens without the cancel when run A simply fails in the browser suite: B is green and ships A's broken code. Smallest fix, on main only: `run: node scripts/ci-scope.mjs "${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' && github.event.before || '' }}" "${{ github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"`. An empty before gives an empty file list, which means browser=true, so main always runs verify:all. Branches keep the saving, but a branch can still show a false green after a red run; say so in the ci-scope.mjs header.
blockers.specRef: docs/DEPLOY.md:46-49 ('A push whose CI fails is not deployed'); 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md §6 l.229-234 and §6.1 ('only a green CI run means the suite passes'); H1 adversarial checklist: 'the Pages deploy no longer waiting for CI on main'

importantFindings.title: The pre-commit phone rule fails open under `diff.noprefix=true`, and for a root Markdown file whose name contains a space
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/privacy-rules.mjs:141 takes the path with `raw.slice(6)`. That assumes the header reads '+++ b/' and has no trailing TAB. scripts/check-staged.mjs:53-66 does not pin the diff prefixes. With noprefix, '.evidence/X/notes.md' is read as 'idence/X/notes.md', so isRecordPath returns false and the phone rule is skipped. Git writes a header such as `+++ b/Owner Notes.md<TAB>`, which fails the `/^[^/]+\.md$/` test. check:repository has no content scan, so nothing else catches it before the push.
importantFindings.reproduction: In a scratch repository: stage .evidence/X/notes.md containing 'contact 333 123 4567 [example number replaced by the orchestrator with the fixtures' synthetic one: the reviewer's own invented number tripped the privacy hook]' and run `node <repo>/scripts/check-staged.mjs`. Default config: refused, exit 1. After `git config diff.noprefix true`: 'PASS: staged privacy check', exit 0. A staged root file 'Owner Notes.md' with the same line: PASS, exit 0. Fix: add "--src-prefix=a/", "--dst-prefix=b/" to the diff arguments (checked on this machine: it overrides diff.noprefix on git 2.33). Change addedLines to `raw.slice(6).replace(/\t$/, "")`, and add two cases to privacy-rules.test.mjs.
importantFindings.specRef: AGENTS.md §17-18 (privacy hook); H1 adversarial checklist: 'a hook that ... passes ... when it should fail'

qolFindings.title: check-docs frozen-file rule: one git call does the same job
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:167-193 adds a second `git diff --name-status` and a Map so that new binaries (numstat '- -') stop counting as edits.
qolFindings.reproduction: Keep the old single numstat loop and add `"--diff-filter=DM"` to it. Additions are excluded; a deleted text file ('0 N'), a binary ('- -') and a modification that removes lines all have deleted !== '0'. This removes the statusOfPath Map, the second git call and about 8 lines. It loses only the separate 'deleted' wording and the case of an empty file being deleted.

qolFindings.title: Recorder: deleting the old flaky list is simpler than comparing timestamps
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/record-verification.mjs:34 and 89-95 use statSync, recordingStarted and an mtime comparison to ignore a stale test-results/e2e-flaky.json.
qolFindings.reproduction: Use `rmSync(flakyPath, { force: true })` before the scripts loop, then `existsSync(flakyPath) ? JSON.parse(...) : []`. It drops the statSync import, recordingStarted and the mtime condition, and no longer depends on the filesystem's timestamp resolution.

qolFindings.title: The 'flaky test filed' check matches the bare test title as a substring
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/milestone.mjs:104-109 uses `backlog.includes(test.title)`. A short title counts as filed if any backlog line contains it, and two specs with the same title share one entry.
qolFindings.reproduction: A flaky test titled 'opens the app' would pass if any backlog sentence contains that phrase. Match `${file} › ${title}`, the exact string run-e2e.mjs:113 already prints.
qolFindings.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md H1 item 4 ('a flaky test listed in evidence and the backlog as a defect')

qolFindings.title: The vitest.config.ts comment promises a loud failure that guarded modules never give
qolFindings.evidence: vitest.config.ts:8-10 says a DOM test missing from the list 'fails loudly with "window is not defined"'. src/features/crews/crewDisplayPreference.ts:4-11 and src/features/students/studentScanNameOrderPreference.ts:20-28 catch that ReferenceError and return their defaults. In Node, a test of the default path that does not touch `window` itself would pass without exercising storage. Today's tests touch `window` in beforeEach, so none is affected yet.
qolFindings.reproduction: Static check: in Node, `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` and `window` is undefined, so the try/catch returns 2 or null. Reword: '...fails with "window is not defined" unless the module catches it; tests of modules that fall back on a storage error belong here as well.'
qolFindings.specRef: H1 adversarial checklist: 'tests that pass in the Node environment only because their DOM assertions no longer run'

qolFindings.title: The header of check-staged.mjs promises a whole-tree check that does not exist
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-staged.mjs:2-3 says 'the whole-tree checks are check:repository's, which the pre-push hook runs'. scripts/git-hooks/pre-push:3 runs only check-push.mjs (history ancestry), and check:repository has no content or phone scan; it checks only that data/private is untracked and that no absolute paths appear.
qolFindings.reproduction: Read pre-push and `grep -n -i 'privacy\|phone' scripts/check-repository.mjs`. Correct the comment. CQ-2 shows why it matters: the hook is the only phone guard.

qolFindings.title: CVC_DOCS_ALLOW_FROZEN_EDIT suppresses problems without leaving a trace
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:167 and 186 skip the report when the variable is set and print nothing. CVC_PRIVACY_OVERRIDE, by contrast, prints its reason (check-staged.mjs:84-87). assertDocsCheck (milestone.mjs:267-280) inherits the environment, so a variable left set in the shell lets milestone:complete accept a frozen-file edit silently.
qolFindings.reproduction: Read the code paths. Fix: when the override suppresses a problem, print `Frozen-file rule overridden: <reason>`.

qolFindings.title: The Playwright testMatch lists are unanchored, hand-written regex alternations
qolFindings.evidence: playwright.config.ts:46-47 and the WebKit list a few lines below. A node check of each regex against tests/e2e/*.spec.ts finds iphone-13-viewport matching 22 files for 22 names, but iphone-13-webkit-core matching 18 files for 17 names: 'duties' also matches u08-duties.spec.ts. That WebKit match predates H1. A mistyped name drops a spec from a project with no warning.
qolFindings.reproduction: Smaller and safer: `const layoutSpecs = ["c1-crew-management", ...]` and `testMatch: layoutSpecs.map((name) => `**/${name}.spec.ts`)`, which anchors on the filename and makes the list easy to diff.
qolFindings.specRef: H1 adversarial checklist: 'a spec that ends up in no project; a geometry check moved off a viewport it needed'

qolFindings.title: The frozen-file rule cannot fire in CI, and the hooks never run it
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:170 compares with `git diff HEAD`, which is empty on CI's clean checkout. The pre-commit hook runs only the privacy check. An edit to archive/ or to completed evidence in an ordinary commit is caught only if someone runs verify:domain or milestone:complete before committing.
qolFindings.reproduction: Commit a one-line deletion in archive/ and run `node scripts/check-docs.mjs`: PASS. Option: accept a base commit (`CVC_DOCS_BASE`; CI passes github.event.before) and diff base..HEAD.

qolFindings.title: A hook blocks the commit with a bare message when `node` is not on PATH
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:4 runs `exec node ...`. A Git GUI started without fnm's per-shell PATH cannot commit and gets no pointer to the fix. Refusing the commit is correct; only the message is missing.
qolFindings.reproduction: Running `env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin sh scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit` prints 'exec: node: not found' and exits 127. Add `command -v node >/dev/null || { echo 'pre-commit: Node is not on PATH; see docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md' >&2; exit 1; }` to both hooks.
qolFindings.specRef: H1 adversarial checklist: 'a hook that blocks a legitimate commit'

qolFindings.title: workflow_dispatch shares the push concurrency group
qolFindings.evidence: ci.yml:7 and 10-12: a manual dispatch on main cancels an in-progress push run, and that commit never deploys, because deploy-pages.yml:37 requires event == 'push'.
